bbslezy.config.title: BBS Lezy
bbslezy.config.general.title: Configuration
bbslezy.config.general.enabled-comment: Caps how many of the film scene's models render at once, keeping the ones closest to the camera. Turn this off when rendering or recording, so every model is drawn.
bbslezy.config.general.render_limit-comm: The number of models the cap keeps visible per frame; everything farther away than the last one inside the budget is held back. 0 disables the limit.
bbslezy.config.general.focus_distance-co: Distance window from camera to prioritize rendering models. Set to 0 for closest models.
bbslezy.config.general.separate_audio_tr: Keep BBS clip audio and Minecraft sounds as two separate tracks in recorded video (track 1 film, track 2 sounds) instead of one mixed track. Only applies when both BBS export options audio and minecraft sounds are on. Requires ffmpeg.
bbslezy.config.general.open_folder_on_im: Automatically open the destination folder in File Explorer when dragging and dropping files into BBS.
bbslezy.config.general.baking_batch_perc: Controls aggressiveness / percentage of total replays processed per frame batch during Look At baking. Higher = faster but heavier, lower = smoother progress bar and gentler on frame pacing.
bbslezy.config.general.discord_enabled-c: Displays rich presence activity in Discord while editing films or playing BBS.
bbslezy.config.general.discord_app_id-co: Optional custom Application ID from Discord Developer Portal. Leave empty to use the default BBS application.
bbslezy.config.general.video_cqp-comment: Constant Quantization Parameter (0-51). Lower value = higher video quality and larger file size. 0 = lossless, 18 = high quality default, 23 = balanced, 28 = small file size.
bbslezy.config.general.video_codec-comme: Video encoding codec: h264 (default, maximum compatibility), h265 (HEVC, better compression), or vp9 (WebM).
bbslezy.ui.replays.duplicate_total_descr: Total number of replays across the selection, split evenly between the ones picked. Each picked replay gets its own category and counts as the first of its share.
